mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIXEDTRANS ( FIXED_ID, NAME, TRANS_DATE, AMOUNT, CATEGORY, PAY_DAY, USER_ID, CURRENCY, FX_AMOUNT ) VALUES ( nextval('SEQ_FNO'), #{name}, #{transDate}, #{amount}, #{category}, #{payDay}, #{userId}, #{currency}, #{fxAmount} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM FIXEDTRANS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY PAY_DAY ASC NULLS LAST, FIXED_ID ASC
